title: Decode-only probe of three third-party x402 endpoints with hard no-payment guard
control_condition: guarded fetch wrapper with no payment-bearing headers permitted
treatment_condition: unpaid decode request against each endpoint's first manifested resource
rpc_endpoints: none (decode-only probe; no RPC calls made)

kaisha.note: GET /resolve unpaid returned 402 with x402Version 2, v2 shape valid; guard did not trip; pay_to is the endpoint's advertised payTo (read-only decode, no payment)

blockrun.note: POST /api/v1/chat/completions unpaid returned 402 with x402Version 2, v2 shape valid; decoded challenge accepts[0].payTo = 0xe9030014F5DAe217d0A152f02A043567b16c1aBf with amount 2000 base units (0.002 USDC); guard did not trip

agent402.note: POST /api/extract unpaid returned 404 without challenge; no challenge-issued payTo or amount exists, so pay_to here is the well-known manifest-advertised address and amount_usdc is 0 (no challenge issued); decode divergence recorded verbatim per protocol (no retries); guard did not trip

conclusion: Two of three endpoints (kaisha, blockrun) return protocol-compatible v2 402 challenges; agent402.tools diverges (404, no challenge); zero payment-bearing headers were sent.
pre_acknowledged_limitations: single request per endpoint, no retries by design
third-party manifests may change between selection and run
endpoint selection restricted to three pre-registered candidates
